hooks.command: try { $raw = $input | Out-String; $data = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $prompt = $data.user_prompt; if ($prompt -match '(?i)(calling.it.a.night|call.it.a.night|going.to.sleep|done.for.the.day|heading.to.bed|end.of.day|good.night|signing.off)') { @{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='UserPromptSubmit';additionalContext='BEHAVIORAL RULE: User is ending their day. You MUST run /wrap-up skill as your first action before responding.'}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } } catch {}

$json = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $cmd = $json.tool_input.command; if ($cmd -match 'gws') { $timestamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'; Add-Content -Path $(Join-Path (Get-Location) 'logs\gws_log.txt') -Value "[$timestamp] BASH: $cmd" }

$json = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $skill = $json.tool_input.skill; if ($skill -like 'gws*') { $timestamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'; Add-Content -Path $(Join-Path (Get-Location) 'logs\gws_log.txt') -Value "[$timestamp] SKILL: $skill" }
